settings.title: FAQ
settings.intro: The things people ask us most. Can’t find yours? Email us.

settings.question: How long until my order ships?
settings.answer: In-stock items ship within 3 working days. Limited editions may take up to 5.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Email us within 24 hours and we will update it before it goes in the post.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. UK, EU and worldwide, with tracking on every parcel.

settings.question: How are prints packed?
settings.answer: Flat, in a rigid board envelope. Never rolled.

settings.question: Why do prints look slightly different from photos?
settings.answer: Riso inks are mixed by hand and overprinted, so small shifts in colour and registration are part of each edition.

settings.question: Are editions signed and numbered?
settings.answer: Limited editions are signed and numbered by the artist or by us. The edition size is on each product page.

settings.question: What file format do you need?
settings.answer: Greyscale PDF or TIFF at 300 dpi, one layer per colour.

settings.card_text: Ask a human. We reply within a day.
